description: Start a free Launchator listing for the user's own website, or for one product's page on a site with several products (up to 3 per website). Loads the page, screens it, and drafts the listing (takes about 30 seconds). Returns the draft and the next step. Needs an access token.

url.description: The product's homepage or its own page, e.g. https://example.com or https://example.com/apps/name

name: submit_product
title: Submit a product
